Synopsis:
    Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill advocates for a prompt Bank Rate hike to preempt persistent inflation driven by the Iran war, arguing an early move could prevent a more aggressive tightening cycle later. He was previously outvoted 6-3 at the July MPC meeting. Markets are currently pricing ~15% probability of a hike at the September meeting, rising to ~70% for November.
